item.title: The myth of the soulmate: Why love isn’t just “destiny”
item.description: Today, dating apps attempt to quantify this search, turning romance into a form of “relation-shopping,” Swami says. Users swipe through dozens of profiles, often feeling the experience is “soulless” rather than meaningful.

item.title: Azerbaijan becomes Washington’s sole strategic ally in Eurasia
item.description: On February 10th, 2026, The Trump Administration and the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan signed a Charter on Strategic Partnership.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev gives interview to France 24 in Munich
item.description: On February 13, President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev was interviewed by France 24 in Munich.

item.title: President Aliyev: Sentenced separatist leaders were “masterminds of war crimes”
item.description: “These are the leaders of the illegal separatist regime, which illegally functioned on our territory, on the territory of the sovereign Azerbaijani state, recognized as such by the entire international community, including Armenia."

item.title: Azerbaijan’s president calls for calm in relations with France
item.description: “I think what is important is my meeting with President Macron at the end of last year, which was very positive, and we agreed to put a restart button. We are ready for that,” said President Ilham Aliyev during his interview with a correspondent from France 24 TV channel.

item.title: Meta’s AI manage profiles after death
item.description: Accounts of deceased users on social networks may soon remain active thanks to a new neural network technology, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: President Aliyev in Munich: peace, power and new Caucasus reality
item.description: President Ilham Aliyev’s presence at the Munich Security Conference this February carried a symbolism that extended well beyond diplomatic routine. Munich has obviously long been a political arena for strategic recalibration, a stage where global powers test narratives and regional leaders present their case to a sceptical international audience. item.title: China tightens automaker pricing rules
item.description: The State Administration for Market Regulation of the People’s Republic of China has released an updated version of the “Rules on Price Behavior,” which apply to automobile manufacturers, dealerships, and spare parts suppliers, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azeri Light CIF price falls to $69.57 per barrel in Italy
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude at Italy’s Augusta port decreased by $0.46, or 0.66 percent, compared to the previous figure, reaching $69.57 per barrel on a CIF basis, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: US Navy surveillance aircraft conduct extended missions near Iranian coast
item.description: A U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon anti-submarine patrol aircraft and an MQ-4C Triton signals intelligence drone carried out hours-long flight operations southeast of Iran’s coastline, according to flight tracking data, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media outlets.
